days.hook: Your new favorite place for skin care just opened in Dallas.
days.body: Solace by Below Zero is here to pamper you: premium facials, hair growth treatments and luxury extensions.
days.cta: Follow us and book your first appointment.
days.scene: Premium med-spa reception, soft natural light, ivory and sage palette, business name in elegant serif, candles and white towels

days.hook: Tuesday 2x1: two facials for $89.99.
days.body: Bring your best friend or come solo and enjoy the experience twice. All facials included in Tuesday's 2x1.
days.scene: Two different women friends on twin spa beds toasting with tea, large '2X1' editorial type, TUESDAY small tracked, FACIALS support line, $89.99 in thin-line oval

days.hook: Your skin holds more than you can see.
days.body: Dirt, oil and dead skin cells hide in your pores. The Deep Cleanse Facial cleans deeply, unclogs pores and leaves skin fresh and balanced.
days.scene: Macro of clean skin with serum droplets and esthetician hands, 'DEEP CLEANSE FACIAL' serif, italic 'DEEP CLEANSING', $89.99

days.hook: Breakouts that won't go away on their own: there's a solution.
days.body: The Acne Facial treats active breakouts, reduces redness and controls excess oil to help prevent future flare-ups.
days.cta: Ask if it's right for your skin.
days.scene: Serene woman on spa bed, esthetician applying treatment, 'ACNE FACIAL' serif, 'CALM, BALANCED SKIN' line, $89.99

days.hook: Which of our facials is yours?
days.body: 1️⃣ Deep Cleanse · 2️⃣ Acne · 3️⃣ Brightening · 4️⃣ Anti-Aging. Tell us which one you need and we'll tell you what to expect.
days.scene: 2x2 grid of four different women portraits, 'WHICH FACIAL IS YOURS?' serif, numerals 1 2 3 4 on tiles

days.topic: What to expect at your appointment
days.hook: Your first appointment, step by step.
days.body: You arrive, relax, and a professional evaluates your skin before every facial. Everything is hygienic, personalized and made for you.
days.scene: Three minimal line icons (welcome tea, skin analysis, relaxing facial), 'YOUR FIRST APPOINTMENT' + 'STEP BY STEP'

days.hook: Sunday = a day to treat yourself.
days.body: A facial isn't a luxury: it's time for you. This week, give yourself an hour of calm.
days.scene: Woman relaxing with towel and closed eyes, golden window light, minimal 'SUNDAY SELF-CARE' script in a corner

days.hook: Your skin has its own light: let it shine.
days.body: The Brightening Facial fades dark spots, unifies tone and boosts radiance for a glowing complexion.
days.scene: Portrait of woman with luminous natural skin, 'BRIGHTENING FACIAL' serif, 'RADIANT, EVEN-TONED SKIN' line, $89.99

days.hook: It's Tuesday: 2x1 on all facials.
days.body: Two facials for $89.99. The perfect plan for a friend, sister or partner.
days.scene: Two different women friends with green face masks on twin spa beds, '2X1' large editorial, TUESDAY tracked, FACIALS, $89.99 thin-line oval

days.hook: Myth: washing your face more often makes it cleaner.
days.body: Over-washing irritates and unbalances your skin. Professional deep cleansing is what truly unclogs pores without harming your barrier.
days.cta: Leave your skin to the experts.
days.scene: Split educational card: 'MYTH' with 'washing more = cleaner skin' crossed out, 'FACT' with 'professional cleansing unclogs pores'

days.hook: Your skin's firmness can be worked on.
days.body: The Anti-Aging Facial reduces fine lines and wrinkles, improves elasticity and restores a youthful, healthy appearance.
days.cta: Ask if it's right for you.
days.scene: Elegant portrait of mature woman with healthy skin, 'ANTI-AGING FACIAL' serif, 'FIRMNESS & YOUTH' line, $89.99

days.hook: Tag someone who needs a facial, stat 😌
days.body: That friend who's always tired, your sister, your mom... They deserve a spa day too.
days.scene: Two different women friends laughing with white towels and masks, 'TAG SOMEONE WHO NEEDS A FACIAL' in negative space

days.hook: Your hair deserves specialized care too.
days.body: Our hair growth treatment cares for your scalp and supports healthier, stronger hair.
days.cta: Ask if it's right for you.

days.hook: Between appointments, your skin is cared for at home.
days.body: Gentle cleansing, hydration and sunscreen. The basics that complement your facial.
days.cta: Want a personalized tip? Message us.

days.hook: How often should you get a facial?
days.body: For visible, lasting results, a monthly routine is ideal. Your skin renews and the benefits add up.
days.cta: Build your monthly plan with us.

days.hook: September starts with 2x1 facials.

days.hook: 18 inches of luxury Remy hair, in minutes.
days.body: Clip N' Go are clip-in extensions made of Remy human hair: 7 pieces, 18", applied in minutes, lasting 6-9 months.

days.body: Wash, condition and style them like your own hair. Store them rolled in their box and they stay perfect.

days.hook: You: length or volume? 🤔

days.hook: Deep Cleanse or Brightening? Let's help you decide.
days.body: Clogged pores? Deep Cleanse. Dark spots or uneven tone? Brightening. Unsure? Book and we'll assess together.
days.scene: Split portrait of two different women, 'DEEP CLEANSE' and 'BRIGHTENING' labels, $89.99

days.hook: A glimpse of your next moment of peace.

days.hook: Hygiene is non-negotiable.

days.hook: Acne isn't just a 'teenager thing'.
days.body: Stress, oil and clogged pores can cause breakouts at any age. The Acne Facial helps control them.

days.body: Dark spots, breakouts, fine lines, pores... Tell us and we'll recommend the right facial.
